script.title: THE AVOCADO TEST
script.scene_zh: 超市蔬果區 · 挑熟的酪梨
script.story_hook: Guacamole night needs avocados that are ready tonight.
script.intro_zh: 酪梨醬之夜，需要今晚就熟的酪梨。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today's produce chat teaches the squeeze and the cap trick.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！蔬果區的對話會教你怎麼捏、怎麼看蒂頭。
script.outro: Now you know the avocado test! Shadow these lines and try it at your store.
script.outro_zh: 現在你懂酪梨測試了！跟著唸這些句子，下次買菜親自試試。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat after me, nice and slow. Copy every line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 請跟著我，一句一句慢慢唸清楚。
script.char_a_description: a male college student around twenty with messy black hair and round wire glasses, his eager grin showing braces, wearing a navy university hoodie, faded jeans, and canvas sneakers, tall and thin build, holding avocados up to the light.
script.char_b_description: a woman in her forties with warm brown skin, short curly gray-flecked hair, wearing an orange store apron over a denim shirt, green gloves tucked in her pocket, medium build, bright welcoming smile.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, which avocado is ready today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi wɪʧ ˌævəˈkɑdoʊ ɪz ˈrɛdi təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，哪顆酪梨今天就能吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready tonight? That's the hard question!
dialogue.zh: 今晚就要熟？這才是最難的問題！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need guacamole for dinner tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚晚餐需要做酪梨醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, show me your picks.
dialogue.zh: 好，給我看你挑的幾顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These two look dark and soft.
dialogue.zh: 這兩顆顏色深，摸起來也軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze them gently, like this.
dialogue.zh: 輕輕捏它們，像這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. Mine feels like a baseball.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。我這顆摸起來像棒球。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means next week, not tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那表示要等到下週，不是今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the really soft ones?
dialogue.zh: 那真的摸起來很軟的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too soft means brown inside, sadly.
dialogue.zh: 太軟就代表裡面發黑，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brown inside? How can you tell?
dialogue.zh: 裡面是黑的？你們怎麼看得出來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peel off the little stem cap. Try this.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil ɔf ðə ˈlɪtəl stɛm kæp traɪ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 摳掉頂部的小蒂頭，試試這顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under mine... it's green!
dialogue.zh: 我這顆下面……是綠的耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green means perfect. Brown means no.
dialogue.zh: 綠色代表完美，褐色就不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a secret test!
dialogue.zh: 這根本是秘密測驗！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! It really is a trick.
dialogue.zh: 哈！這真的是個訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that trick work for all of them?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt trɪk wɝk fɔr ɔl ʌv ðəm/
dialogue.zh: 這個訣竅對每一顆都有效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty much. Try this big one.
dialogue.zh: 差不多都有效。試試這顆大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cap says... dark brown. Ugh.
dialogue.zh: 蒂頭顯示……深褐色。唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to the bin it goes!
dialogue.zh: 再放回桶裡吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finding a good one is hard work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪndɪŋ ə ɡʊd wʌn ɪz hɑrd wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 挑到一顆好的真不容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to my Tuesday mornings.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎來到我週二早上的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this small one any better?
dialogue.zh: 這顆小的會好一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze... nice, just a little soft.
dialogue.zh: 捏捏看……很好，只有一點軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the cap? Yes, it's green!
dialogue.zh: 蒂頭呢？是的，是綠的！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one's dinner-ready. Take it.
dialogue.zh: 那顆今晚正好吃。買它吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome. Should I grab a second one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔsəm ʃʊd aɪ ɡræb ə ˈsɛkənd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。我要再拿一顆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For guacamole, always make extra.
dialogue.zh: 做酪梨醬永遠要多備幾顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good advice. My roommates eat fast.
dialogue.zh: 好建議。我的室友們吃很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roommates are the best clean-up crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrumˌmeɪts ɑr ðə bɛst klin ʌp kru/
dialogue.zh: 室友就是最棒的清盤小隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if this one turns out bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ðɪs wʌn tɜrnz aʊt bæd/
dialogue.zh: 如果這顆打開卻是壞的怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring it back, no problem.
dialogue.zh: 那就帶回來，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even without the receipt?
dialogue.zh: 就算沒有收據也可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even without! We trust the cap trick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivɪn wɪˈðaʊt wi trʌst ðə kæp trɪk/
dialogue.zh: 沒收據也行！我們相信蒂頭測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You produce people are saints, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，你們蔬果區的人都是聖人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saints in aprons, for sure. Why tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪnts ɪn ˈeɪprənz fɚ ʃʊr waɪ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是穿圍裙的聖人啦。為什麼是今晚？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom is visiting; guacamole is her favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɑm ɪz ˈvɪzɪtɪŋ ˌɡwɑkəˈmoʊli ɪz hɚ ˈfeɪvɚɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽這幾天來住；酪梨醬是她最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aw, that's sweet. Does she cook too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ ðæts swit dʊz ʃi kʊk tu/
dialogue.zh: 噢，真窩心。她也會下廚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well... she teaches cooking, actually.
dialogue.zh: 其實……她是烹飪老師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move! Check two caps, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muv tʃɛk tu kæps dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 聰明！多檢查兩顆蒂頭，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two green caps, one perfect squeeze. Done!
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɡrin kæps wʌn ˈpɜrfɪkt skwiːz dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 兩顆綠蒂頭，一顆手感完美。搞定！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see them both... yes, beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 給我看這兩顆……嗯，很漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any trick to keep the cut one fresh?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni trɪk tə kip ðə kʌt wʌn frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 切開的酪梨有什麼保鮮訣竅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lemon juice on top keeps the green.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛmən dʒus ɑn tɑp kips ðə ɡrin/
dialogue.zh: 上面淋檸檬汁就能保持翠綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Genius! Any other guacamole secrets?
dialogue.zh: 太神了！還有別的酪梨醬秘方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt first, then lime, and never a blender.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔlt fɜrst ðɛn laɪm ænd ˈnɛvɚ ə ˈblɛndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先加鹽，再來萊姆汁，千萬別用果汁機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never a blender? My roommate owns one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ ə ˈblɛndɚ maɪ ˈrumˌmeɪt oʊnz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 千萬別用果汁機？我室友就有一台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then borrow his fork instead. Ha!
dialogue.zh: 那就跟他借叉子來壓吧。哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should write a guacamole book!
dialogue.zh: 你該寫一本酪梨醬的書！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me? I just help people pick well.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi aɪ dʒʌst hɛlp ˈpipəl pɪk wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 我嗎？我只是幫大家挑到好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just sold me a story with three avocados.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dʒʌst soʊld mi ə ˈstɔri wɪθ θri ˌævəˈkɑdoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 你講著故事就賣了我三顆酪梨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's my sales pitch, and it's honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts maɪ seɪlz pɪʧ ænd ɪts ˈɑnɪst/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我的銷售方式，而且很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It worked completely. Where's the register?
dialogue.zh: 完全有效。收銀台在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past the bananas, first lane on the right.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ðə bəˈnænəz fɜrst leɪn ɑn ðə raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 經過香蕉，右手邊第一條通道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question: are limes nearby?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛsʧən ɑr laɪmz ˈnɪr baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 再問一個：萊姆就在附近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right here! Four in a bag, fresh today.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt hɪr fɔr ɪn ə bæɡ frɛʃ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡！一袋四顆，今天剛到很新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. That's everything my mom needs.
dialogue.zh: 完美。我媽媽要的全在這了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good luck with the guacamole tonight!
dialogue.zh: 祝你今晚酪梨醬大成功！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! I'll report back about the caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪl rɪˈpɔrt bæk əˈbaʊt ðə kæps/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我會回來告訴你蒂頭測試的結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do! Happy cooking with mom!
dialogue.zh: 一定要喔！和媽媽愉快下廚！

script.youtube_title_en: "Green Means Perfect" — Picking Ripe Avocados at the Store
script.youtube_description:
60句挑酪梨真實對話，聽完就能自己捏熟度、看蒂頭、問保存方法！

這一集走進超市的蔬果區。一位大學生今晚要為來訪的媽媽做酪梨醬，卻不會挑熟的酪梨。店員一步步教他：輕輕捏、摳開小蒂頭看顏色、兩顆一起備，還送他檸檬汁保綠和不用果汁機的小秘方。

你會練到：
- 開口求助：「Excuse me, which avocado is ready today?」
- 確認保存方法：「Any trick to keep the cut one fresh?」
- 詢問退換：「Even without the receipt?」
- 道別與回報：「Thanks! I'll report back about the caps.」

後半段為逐句聽力與跟讀練習，建議先聽兩遍，再一句一句跟著唸。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

喜歡這集請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，每天一段英文對話陪你練習！

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of real produce-aisle English you can hear and use today.

In this episode, a college student needs ripe avocados tonight for his mom's favorite guacamole. The produce clerk teaches him the squeeze test, the stem cap trick, the lemon juice secret, and even what to do if one turns out brown inside.

You will practice:
- Asking for help: Excuse me, which avocado is ready today?
- The key rule: Green means perfect. Brown means no.
- Checking storage: Any trick to keep the cut one fresh?
- Friendly goodbye: Thanks! I'll report back about the caps.

The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing practice. Listen twice, then repeat every line out loud.

Great for A2 learners: no memorizing needed, just listen and you will start using it.

If you enjoy this lesson, subscribe, like, and turn on notifications for a daily English dialogue!

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

📌 影片簡介：
酪梨要怎麼挑，才能今晚剛好熟？🥑 蒂頭顏色真的有暗號嗎？切開變黑該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進超市蔬果區，看一位大學生在店員教導下，學會捏熟度、看蒂頭，幫媽媽端出一盤完美的酪梨醬。

你會聽到：
🤏 手感測試——「Squeeze them gently, like this.」輕輕一捏就知道熟度。
🟢 蒂頭暗號——「Green means perfect. Brown means no.」一眼看懂新舊。
🍋 保鮮秘訣——「Lemon juice on top keeps the green.」切開也不怕黑。
🧾 貼心保證——「Even without! We trust the cap trick.」沒收據也能換。

後半段是逐句聽力加跟讀練習🎧，建議先從頭聽過，再一句一句跟著唸，讓句子自然上口。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者——不用背，多聽就會用，生活情境一次學透。

祝你下次挑酪梨，每一顆都是綠蒂頭！
